<div class="doxyMemberDoc">

<p>A reference to an Interned <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/foldingsetnodeid">FoldingSetNodeID</a> for this node.</p>


<p>The Allocator in <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/selectiondag">SelectionDAG</a> holds the data. <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/structs/llvm/sdvtlist">SDVTList</a> contains all types which are frequently accessed in <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/selectiondag">SelectionDAG</a>. The size of this list is not expected to be big so it won't introduce a memory penalty.</p>
